data.exact_reserve_text: An overall deterioration of GBP 0.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to deteriorations of GBP 0.4 million on casualty reinsurance and GBP 0.2 million on marine reinsurance partially offset by an improvement of GBP 0.5 million on property reinsurance.

named_events.loss_description: Major bushfires affecting Australia, which started in 2019 but continued into 2020... mitigated by the comprehensive reinsurance protections purchased by Syndicate 2121 as the host syndicate.
devastating tornadoes affecting the state of Tennessee... mitigated by the comprehensive reinsurance protections purchased by Syndicate 2121 as the host syndicate.

largest natural catastrophe loss incurred by the syndicate was in respect of Hurricane Laura. The losses from COVID-19, Australian bushfires, Hurricane Laura, and the Tennessee tornadoes, are all mitigated by the comprehensive reinsurance protections purchased by Syndicate 2121 as the host syndicate.

COVID-19 related net losses GBP 15.7 million... mitigated by the comprehensive reinsurance protections purchased by Syndicate 2121 as the host syndicate. Syndicate 6134 has material exposure to losses arising from the COVID-19 pandemic. The ultimate costs of these claims are subject to a great deal of uncertainty which, combined with their total size, increases the level of uncertainty for the total reserves of the syndicate significantly beyond the normal range of uncertainty for the liabilities of an insurance carrier at this stage of development.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross strengthening of GBP 0.1 million on prior years' provisions in 2020. This was driven by deteriorations of GBP 0.4 million on casualty reinsurance and GBP 0.2 million on marine reinsurance, partially offset by a favourable development (improvement) of GBP 0.5 million on property reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: deteriorations of GBP 0.4 million on casualty reinsurance
improvement of GBP 0.5 million on property reinsurance

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is explicitly stated as gross in the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note. The claims development triangle on page 14 shows a different prior year movement for 2018 (+1.505m), but the explicit narrative on page 9 is preferred as the primary source for overall prior year development.
